title: Landstar's Approach to Safety and Innovation
summary: Our unwavering commitment to high-quality service and safety has made Landstar the success that it is today and will continue to be our core principles for the future.
body_markdown:
Landstar is a powerful name in the transportation industry. When you see it on a truck, when a sales agent says it in a meeting, when one of our capacity providers makes a delivery, people know Landstar and what it represents: one of the safest, most secure and reliable transportation providers in the business today.


Our unwavering commitment to high-quality service and safety has made Landstar the success that it is today and will continue to be our core principles for the future.


To learn more about Landstar's approach to safety and innovation, click on the below image to view or download ***[The Power to Move You](https://cloud.3dissue.net/29953/29847/30285/45594/index.html?89302)*** flipbook.
